title: About the Resort
summary: A residential wellness and eco-tourism sanctuary on the Centurion University campus — where classical Ayurveda meets restored forest, an organic farm and quiet, sustainable luxury.

sections.heading: Healing, the way nature intended
body: Centurion Wellness Eco Tourism Resorts was created by Centurion University of Technology and Management as a living campus for whole-person health. Guests come for a few days of rest or a full residential Panchakarma programme, and leave having reconnected with a slower rhythm.

Everything here is designed to lower the noise: architecture that opens to the tree line, a kitchen that cooks to your doctor's prescription, and 120 acres of trails, water bodies and farmland to wander.

title: Panchakarma Treatments
summary: The classical five-action purification therapy — preparation, elimination and rejuvenation — delivered over a residential stay under daily medical supervision.

body: Panchakarma is not a spa package. It is a staged medical process: internal and external oleation (Snehana), fomentation (Swedana), the main cleansing actions (Vamana, Virechana, Basti, Nasya, Raktamokshana as indicated), and a carefully paced rebuilding phase.

items.title: Purva Karma
items.text: Preparation — oleation and fomentation to mobilise toxins.

items.title: Pradhana Karma
items.text: The main cleansing action selected for your constitution and condition.

items.title: Paschat Karma
items.text: Graded diet, rest and Rasayana to rebuild strength and immunity.

items.a: A meaningful Panchakarma runs 7–21 nights. Shorter stays use preparatory and palliative therapies rather than full elimination.
A pre-arrival medical questionnaire and on-site assessment determine suitability. Some conditions and medications require modification.

items.q: Will I be able to work?
items.a: We recommend treating it as full rest. Wi-Fi is available but the schedule is intentionally demanding of your time.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
summary: Arrival, programmes, medical suitability, food, connectivity and cancellation.

items.q: How do I choose a programme?
items.a: Tell us your goal and available dates through the enquiry form or booking flow; a wellness advisor recommends a programme and length. Your on-site doctor confirms and adjusts it.

items.q: Do I need to be unwell to come?
items.a: No. Many guests come for preventive rest and rejuvenation. Programmes scale from a gentle 3-night reset to full clinical Panchakarma.
Yes — it's part of booking. It lets the clinical team prepare your plan and flag anything that needs modification.
All meals are vegetarian, mostly organic and grown on site. Programme guests eat to their prescribed diet chart. Allergies and preferences are recorded in the guest portal.

items.q: Will I have phone signal and Wi-Fi?
items.a: Wi-Fi covers the rooms and public areas. Digital-detox programmes ask you to hand devices in voluntarily.
Full refund up to 14 days before arrival, 50% up to 7 days, non-refundable inside 72 hours — with medical exceptions. Full terms are shown at checkout.
